ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 rider-cancellation fee; no refund, no account action. If the rider wants the fee waived, direct her to the RydeHELP fee-waiver route within 30 days of the trip.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation on record is the rider's own: accepted 21:30:00 and cancelled by rider at 21:33:20, with the $6.61 cancellation fee charged [F2][F5]. NS-0 routes a cancellation fee only through its own branches, and where cancelled_by = rider on an instant booking the fee is judged under NS-4, not NS-1/NS-2 (which govern a driver-claimed no-show cancellation) [F2][NS-0].

Under NS-4, a rider who cancels more than 3 minutes after matching owes the fee; here the cancellation was 3 min 20 s (200 s) after acceptance, so the $6.61 is chargeable [F2][NS-4]. The rider's own advocate admits she cancelled 20 seconds past the three-minute mark [F2][NS-4].

The no-show branch the rider relies on is not engaged. NS-1/NS-2 apply when the driver cancels claiming the rider did not show; that requires an arrival confirmation (I'm Here tap or platform auto-arrival) [F3][F4]. No arrival was ever confirmed — driver_arrived_at is null and driver_pressed_here_at is null [F3][F4] — so NS-1 (i) never opens, and no no-show cancellation exists for NS-2 to refund [F4][NS-1][NS-2]. Indeed the closest approach was 2137 m at 21:32:55, never within 200 m [F1], which confirms no arrival but does not convert this into a no-show refund case.

The chat does not change this: the driver's 21:31 message "About 5 min, traffic" [F8] and the rider's "How long will you be?" [F7] show the rider knew the driver had not arrived and cancelled on that basis. Ryde publishes no rule waiving the fee where the driver is behind the ETA; the driver's 21:31 "traffic" explanation is not corroborated (only band 6, 50-59 km/h on Pasir Panjang Drive 3, no incidents, fair weather) [F11][F12][F13], and NS-1's arrival preconditions simply were not met [F1][F4][NS-1]. The remedy for a fee the rider considers unfair is the RydeHELP fee-waiver route within 30 days, and Ryde retains discretion [F5][NS-7].

No account flag is warranted. Flagging under NS-2 attaches only where the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius — no tap was made at all here, so the fraud limb is not engaged [F4][NS-2]. RD-6 concerns repeated upheld route-deviation disputes and does not apply to this no-show/cancellation case [F15][RD-6]. The driver's profile (1 upheld no-show dispute in 90 days) is a profile fact that cannot alone decide or flag the case [F15][NS-2].

Requested refund is $6.61; no clause makes it refundable, so the amount is null and the fee stands.
